units.source_text: 女子发现岛村走近，就把胸脯伏在窗栏上。

en.t: When the woman saw Shimamura coming closer, she leaned her chest against the window rail.

units.source_text: 这种姿态，不是怯懦，相反地，在这种夜色映衬下，显得无比坚强。

en.t: That posture was not timidity; on the contrary, set against the darkness of the night, it appeared extraordinarily strong.
Shimamura thought to himself: here it comes again.
